name: Okta, Inc.
product: Okta for AI Agents plus Agent SSO and Cross App Access govern AI-agent identity; core Workforce and Customer Identity and Okta Identity Governance drive demand. New products were about 30 pct of Q2 bookings, OIG the top contributor, about 40 pct ACV uplift when included (2026-08-26).
demand: Volume and mix, not price. Over 600 customers above $1M ACV, $1M+ ACV customers growing over 20 pct, cRPO +14 pct (2026-08-26). Mix shifted via new products at 30 pct of bookings. Agent SSO is bundled free into core SSO, adding volume not price (2026-08-24).
pricing_power: Bundling Agent SSO free into core SSO (2026-08-24) compresses agentic monetization; the pro-services shift to partners trims FY27 revenue about one point (2026-08-26); stock-based compensation ran $114M in Q2; and Microsoft or platform-vendor bundling could force price cuts against the 28 pct non-GAAP operating margin.
competition: Microsoft Entra ID, bundled with Microsoft 365 and already about 40 pct of access management, is the closest low-cost substitute (Oktane summit 2026-09-23). Open-source Keycloak and regional or Chinese identity providers are further substitutes. Cross App Access is open, so rivals can adopt it freely.
market_strategy: 2026-09-23 keynote: agents need deep broad persistent access; we must eliminate the tradeoff between security and innovation; the agentic control plane could be bigger than all of identity today. 2026-08-26 guidance: FY27 revenue $3.216-3.226B, non-GAAP operating margin 26 pct, free cash flow $910-930M.
bull: Q2 FY27 (2026-08-26): revenue $805M +11%, cRPO +14%, GAAP operating income $107M vs $41M, FY27 guidance raised, $2.3B cash, zero convertible debt; new products 30% of bookings; 72 raises/34 firms in 90d.
bear: Agentic AI is GA but management says it is too small to show in numbers; Agent SSO bundled free compresses monetization; Microsoft Entra (~40% share) is a bundled low-cost substitute; pro-services shift trims FY27 revenue ~1pt.
falsifier: Q3 FY27 results (~late Nov 2026): cRPO growth below guided 11-12% or revenue below $813-817M; or FY27 revenue landing under $3.216B.

web_who_benefits_next: Second-order: channel and GSI partners, engaged in all top-20 Q2 deals (2026-08-26). web_margin_collapse_risk: Bundling Agent SSO free into core SSO (2026-08-24) compresses agentic monetization; the pro-services shift to partners trims FY27 revenue about one point (2026-08-26); stock-based compensation ran $114M in Q2; and Microsoft or platform-vendor bundling could force price cuts against the 28 pct non-GAAP operating margin.
web_low_cost_substitute: Microsoft Entra ID, bundled with Microsoft 365 and already about 40 pct of access management, is the closest low-cost substitute (Oktane summit 2026-09-23). Open-source Keycloak and regional or Chinese identity providers are further substitutes. Cross App Access is open, so rivals can adopt it freely.
web_ceo_promised: 2026-09-23 keynote: agents need deep broad persistent access; we must eliminate the tradeoff between security and innovation; the agentic control plane could be bigger than all of identity today. 2026-08-26 guidance: FY27 revenue $3.216-3.226B, non-GAAP operating margin 26 pct, free cash flow $910-930M.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. 2026-08-26 Q2: revenue $805M +11 pct, GAAP operating income $107M vs $41M a year earlier, cRPO acceleration to +14 pct, record non-Q4 bookings, over 600 $1M+ ACV customers, FY27 guidance raised, $350M convertible notes settled in cash, $125M shares repurchased.
web_what_would_falsify: Observables: Q3 FY27 (about late Nov 2026) cRPO growth below guided 11-12 pct or revenue below $813-817M; FY27 revenue landing under $3.216B; Okta for AI Agents still too small to show in numbers by FY28; or Microsoft Entra or a platform vendor clearly winning the agentic identity control plane.
